limitations: No production canary, fleet deployment, post-deployment native API result, real VLESS traffic result, tunneled-DNS observation, or public egress-IP proof is provided; these remain release gates.

Complete source review, bounded native verification, race/regression testing, provenance verification without fake READY, production canary, fleet application through the normal Sanaei API/controller, and pinned rollback rehearsal to 435486a7369965366852f48e7514efe7d6a41293 before release.
